system.description: Force 6) Zephyrs appear as great beautiful falcons with colorful cirrus plumage. They are the apex predaof the elemental Plane of Air. Those who get a closer view see that the zephyr's beak is serrated savage teeth. It is a fast flyer, striking from above to take out welkins, wafts, and any traveler wanders too far into their territory.
